Class ScopeBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.scope.ScopeBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Scopable
public class ScopeBuilder extends Object implements Scopable
Builder pattern for scopes. Use Scope.builder(), Scope.setScope(org.clafer.ast.AstClafer, int), Scope.defaultScope(int), Scope.intLow(int), Scope.intHigh(int), Scope.mulLow(int), Scope.mulHigh(int), Scope.stringLength(int), Scope.charLow(char), or Scope.charHigh(char) to construct the builder. Will provide defaults for the parameters that are not explicitly specified.
Author:
jimmy

      public ScopeBuilder setScope(AstClafer clafer, int scope)
      Set the scope of the Clafer. If the scope is already set for the Clafer, then the new scope overrides the previous one.
      Parameters:
      clafer - the Clafer
      scope - the scope of the clafer
      Returns:
      this builder

    • adjustScope

      public ScopeBuilder adjustScope(AstClafer clafer, int adjust)
      Adjust the scope of the Clafer. If the Clafer already has a scope then newScope = oldScope + adjust. Otherwise newScope = defaultScope + adjust.
      Parameters:
      clafer - the Clafer
      adjust - increment the scope by this amount
      Returns:
      this builder
